lease_id.description: Unique identifier for this credential lease

issuer.description: Entity that issued this credential lease

subject.description: Principal to whom this credential lease is issued

valid_from.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this lease becomes valid

valid_until.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this lease expires

bound_clearance_id.description: Identifier of the REHT GovernanceClearance to which this lease is bound

bound_clearance_digest.description: Cryptographic digest of the clearance to which this lease is bound

token_reference.description: Reference to the actual credential token (never the token value itself)

token_rotatable.description: Whether this credential token can be rotated during the lease period

lease_digest.description: Cryptographic digest of this complete lease record
